summary: Nam Tai Property Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing two onshore financing transactions totaling RMB 740 million, led by a RMB 700 million 15-year fixed asset loan from Ping An Bank at 3.5% fixed rate and a RMB 40 million five-year facility. The funds will refinance existing debt and support working capital. This is not a special situation but a routine capital structure optimization through debt refinancing.
